verdict.rationale: Stripe's stablecoin payments docs name the supported coins and the network for each: USDC on Tempo, Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and Base; USDP on Ethereum and Solana (US-only); USDG on Ethereum (US-only). Customers choose their preferred stablecoin and network, and community discussion independently confirms USDC-on-Solana support. Missing for 10: no USDT support in the documented list, so a key coin the story names is absent; regional limits on non-USDC coins further narrow coverage of what customers actually hold.
